subject: Request: temporary H100 allocation + burst pricing / reservation hold - NimbleHealth
messages:
From: Kim Alvarez <kim.alvarez@nimblehealth.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity request + temporary H100 bump and reservation hold

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the overview this morning. Quick recap and asks from our side so procurement can move:

- We're planning a production rollout in mid-November for our real-time inference pipeline. Baseline steady state is ~120 A100-equivalent GPU-hrs/day but during launch we expect 2-3x spike for ~4 weeks.
- We'd like to request a temporary allocation of H100-class instances (equivalent performance to our benchmarks) for the launch window to reduce latency.
- Can Redwood place a 45-day reservation hold on capacity (no charge while hold is active) while we finalize PO? We may convert to a reservation after procurement completes.
- We also need a burst pricing structure for the first 60 days (preferably a capped blended overage rate) and a one-time onboarding credit.

I've attached a short forecast (nimble_usage_forecast_q4.xlsx) and our expected SOW language. Procurement will want estimated cost and contract timeline to approve. Can you confirm what you need from us?

Appreciate the help — Kim
Director of ML Platforms
NimbleHealth
Attachments: nimble_usage_forecast_q4.xlsx, SOW_NimbleHealth_v3.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kim Alvarez <kim.alvarez@nimblehealth.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request + temporary H100 bump and reservation hold

Kim — thanks, got the forecast and SOW. Short answer: we can often support temporary H100 allocations, but this is a SKU/contract exception and needs deal-desk + finance sign-off.

Next steps from our side:
- I will open an internal escalation with a brief (attaching a one-page deal brief) and ask for temporary reservation hold + burst-overage proposal.
- Could you confirm the hard dates for the launch window (start/end) and whether you need exclusivity on those H100 machines?

I cc'd Lauren (deal desk) to start pricing. Will loop in finance/exec if needed.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: deal-brief.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 12:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request + temporary H100 bump and reservation hold

Team — Ben asked me to jump in. Summary of the ask:
- Temporary H100-class allocation for a 4–6 week launch (Nimble estimates 2–3x baseline for ~30 days).
- 45-day reservation hold (no charge while they finalize PO) with option to convert to a paid reservation.
- Burst overage with a capped blended rate for first 60 days, plus a one-time onboarding credit.

Initial pricing thought: granting H100 SKU + reservation hold is material vs standard Dedicated terms. Requesting exec approval for:
- SKU exception (H100) for initial 60 days
- Reservation hold (45 days)
- One-time onboarding credit up to $12,000
- Temporary burst discount of 20% off our published overage rate for first billing cycle (subject to cap)

Can finance provide a recommended upper bound on discount and whether we can accept a 45-day hold before start of billing?

Attaching brief.

—Lauren
Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: deal-brief.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Executive Approvals <exec-approvals@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Escalation: NimbleHealth – temporary H100 allocation + reservation hold (requesting approval)

Fwding — short ask for review and signoff. Excerpt from Lauren: "SKU exception (H100) for initial 60 days, reservation hold (45 days), onboarding credit up to $12k, temporary burst discount 20% for first billing cycle (subject to cap)."

Business rationale: NimbleHealth is a mid-market customer with strategic healthcare data integrations and a clear path to expansion (expecting additional reserved growth in H2). Granting a limited, time-boxed SKU bump would materially reduce latency for their launch and decrease churn risk.

Risks/controls proposed by Lauren/Finance: PO required before converting to paid reservation; a cap on discounted burst hours; finance approval for credit.

Request: please approve any of the following options (we'll implement the one approved):
A) Full approval: H100 allocation + 45-day reservation hold + 20% burst discount + $12k onboarding credit.
B) Partial: H100 allocation + 30-day reservation hold + 15% burst discount + $8k credit.
C) Deny: revert to standard A100 allocation and normal overage pricing (we can offer performance tuning instead).

Need decision within 48 hours to meet Nimble's procurement timeline.

—Markus
VP, Sales Operations

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Escalation: NimbleHealth – temporary H100 allocation + reservation hold (requesting approval)

Markus / team — finance input below. Key points:
- We can support a limited SKU exception but must limit downside exposure. Recommend Option B with modifications: 30-day reservation hold (not 45), capped discounted burst up to 600 GPU-hrs total, and a maximum onboarding credit of $8,000.
- Suggest burst overage blended rate: $9.50 / GPU-hr (after the 15% discount off standard overage). This yields a clear cap and predictable revenue recovery.
- Require signed PO and SOW before conversion to paid reservation. If procurement misses PO deadline, the reservation hold will lapse and normal billing resumes.

If execs are comfortable, finance will prepare a short amendment with the conditional terms.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Finance — Revenue Operations

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kim Alvarez <kim.alvarez@nimblehealth.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request + temporary H100 bump and reservation hold

Kim — quick update and a conditional proposal to keep momentum:

We can offer a time-boxed plan while procurement completes:
- Mixed pool with H100-class for critical low-latency pathways plus A100 fallback for batch jobs.
- 30-day reservation hold (no charges while hold is active).
- Capped discounted burst: up to 600 GPU-hrs at $9.50 / GPU-hr (this reflects finance-approved 15% discount).
- Onboarding credit: $8,000 applied to the first invoice once converted to paid reservation.

Conditions: PO and signed SOW required for conversion; if PO not received by the end of the hold, we will release the held capacity and standard overage pricing applies.

If that looks OK I will send a short amendment and a DocuSign link for the SOW. Attaching the amended SOW and forecast for your review.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Attachments: SOW_NimbleHealth_v3.pdf, nimble_usage_forecast_q4.xlsx

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Kim Alvarez <kim.alvarez@nimblehealth.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: conditional SKU exception + 30-day hold + capped burst discount (NimbleHealth)

Ben / team / Kim — approving Option B with the finance refinements. Final decision items:
- Approve: H100-class allocation (time-boxed), 30-day reservation hold, capped discounted burst up to 600 GPU-hrs at $9.50 / GPU-hr, onboarding credit $8,000.
- Requirement: Signed PO and SOW within the 30-day hold to convert to a paid reservation. Finance to prepare the amendment with the cancellation clause.
- Operational note: Infra to tag this reservation as "nimble-esc-1193" and set an automated release if PO not received by 2026-10-15.

Ben — proceed with the DocuSign and finalize the amendment. Good work on keeping the controls tight.

—Markus Klein
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
